title: Finding peace, one click at a time: AI-made virtual sanctuaries draw young Koreans
caption:
Young people in Korea are turning to AI-built digital temples for a moment of quiet. With no chat or social pressure, these virtual spaces offer a way to decompress.

Source: Koreaherald - Finding peace, one click at a time: AI-made virtual sanctuaries draw young Koreans

https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10921693
